question:
Find the simplified value of the following expression:

(3⁴ × 3−²) ÷ (3³ × 3−⁵) × (3⁶)−¹
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine all powers of base 3 in a single step using basic exponent rules.

Expression = 3⁴ − ² ÷ 3³ − ⁵ × 3−⁶

Expression = 3² ÷ 3−² × 3−⁶

By left-to-right calculation: 3² − ⁽−²⁾ − ⁶ = 3⁴ − ⁶ = 3−²

3−² = 1 / 3² = 1/9

**∴ The correct answer is 1/9.**
